> 第745章 小妖女（第1页）
小妖女（小妖女（第22页）持剑卫享有秦家旁系的所有待遇。
他们如影子一般，追随在秦家子弟的身侧，同生共死。
是护卫者，是主仆，是持剑婢女，更是秦媚儿的闺中密友和玩伴。
“你们两个笨蛋，除了修炼之外根本什么也不懂，我秦媚儿什么都不缺，要的道侣，自然要符合我的心意。”
“他们连半点我的喜欢都讨不到，该自责反思的人，是他们，可不是我。”
“我的道侣自然应该气质无双，天下一绝，白衣似风，如，如，如……”
两个婢女歪歪脑袋，疑惑抬头，顺着秦媚儿的目光看了过去。
站在玲珑阁二楼楼梯上的，有一位白衣男子，微微垂着眼眸，朝外走来。
在见到他的第一时间，几个形容词就几乎不受控制的浮现在众人的脑海之中。
秦媚儿一声低喃，眼神一错不肯错开，注视着那位白衣男子。
这段时间是方家的考核时间，其他城池的方家人争先恐后的朝着沧澜城涌来，会是方家旁系吗？他是谁？林玄当然也注意到了那红衣小姑娘观察自己的目光。
但对方没有任何恶意，他也就不再过多注意。
他在这里，竟是看到了好几种自己需要的灵丹，还有未被炼制的灵草。
零零总总加起来，价值约莫超过了三千万。
于玲珑阁内，所有一切皆不可擅拿，客人选取拿到的，只是手符，凭借一枚枚手符，结账之后，自然可以拿到属于自己的丹药和灵草。
柜台前，管事将林玄选中的手符一一看过之后，微微计算了一番，满脸笑意开口。
“公子，这几枚丹药和灵草，总价值三千五百万，您要如何支付？”
不过，他身上的灵石只有一千八百万。
思索了短短一瞬，林玄开口问道：“帝阶宝器是什么价格？”
他手里倒是还有一部分帝阶的宝器，可以用作买卖，换取灵石。
但管事还没有开口，在他身后却陡然传来了一道略有些张扬的声音。
“三千五百万？哪里用得到宝器置换。”
“这位公子的账记在我头上吧，就当作是交个朋友。”
管事惊了惊，有些愕然开口：“这……小姐？”
林玄回过头望去，便见那红衣小姑娘，已经来到了自己的身边，一双灿若桃花的眼直勾勾盯着自己，虽然有些冒昧，但是眸中只有纯粹的欣赏，倒是也不叫人心生厌恶。
只是，接下来，她说的话，却有些让林玄哭笑不得。
“公子并非我沧澜城中人，可有归属？可有婚配？”
“若是无有，要不要考虑入我秦家？”
“若入我秦家，这三千五百万，便是九牛一毛哦。”

> Chapter 745 Little Demon Girl (Page 1)
The sword-wielding guard of the Little Demon Girl (Little Demon Girl (p. 22)) enjoys all the benefits of the Qin family's collateral branches.
They are like shadows, following the Qin family's children, living and dying together.
She is a protector, a master and servant, a sword-wielding maid, and even Qin Meier's close friend and playmate.
"You two idiots know nothing except cultivation. I, Qin Mei'er, am lacking in everything. The Taoist companion I want must naturally meet my wishes."
"They can't even please me at all. They are the ones who should blame themselves and reflect on themselves, not me."
"My Taoist companion should naturally have an unparalleled temperament, be unique in the world, and be dressed in white like the wind, like, like, like..."
The two maids tilted their heads, raised their heads in confusion, and followed Qin Meier's gaze.
Standing on the stairs on the second floor of Linglong Pavilion, there was a man in white walking towards the outside with his eyes slightly lowered.
The first time they saw him, several adjectives appeared in everyone's minds almost uncontrollably.
Qin Meier murmured, her eyes refusing to look away as she stared at the man in white.
This period of time is the assessment time for the Fang family. The Fang family members from other cities are rushing towards Canglan City. Could they be a branch of the Fang family? Who is he? Of course, Lin Xuan also noticed the little girl in red observing him.
But the other party didn't have any ill intentions, so he stopped paying too much attention.
Here, he actually saw several kinds of spiritual pills that he needed, as well as unrefined spiritual herbs.
The total sum of zero and zero is worth approximately more than 30 million.
In Linglong Pavilion, everything is not allowed to be taken without permission. What the guests choose to get are just hand talismans. With each hand talisman, after paying the bill, they can naturally get their own elixirs and spiritual herbs.
In front of the counter, the steward looked at the hand talismans selected by Lin Xuan one by one, made some calculations, and spoke with a smile on his face.
"Sir, these pills and spiritual herbs are worth a total of 35 million. How do you want to pay for them?"
However, he only has 18 million spiritual stones.
After thinking for a short moment, Lin Xuan asked: "What is the price of an emperor-level treasure?"
He still has some imperial-level treasures in his hand, which can be traded and exchanged for spiritual stones.
But before the steward could speak, a slightly loud voice suddenly came from behind him.
"Thirty-five million? How can I replace it with a treasure?"
"Let me keep this young master's account on my head, just think of it as making a friend."
The steward was startled and said in shock: "This...Miss?"
Lin Xuan looked back and saw that the little girl in red had come to his side, staring straight at him with a pair of bright peach blossom eyes. Although it was a bit presumptuous, there was only pure appreciation in her eyes, which was not disgusting.
However, what she said next made Lin Xuan dumbfounded.
"Young Master is not from Canglan City, but does he belong to me? Can he get married?"
"If not, do you want to consider joining my Qin family?"
"If you join my Qin family, these 35 million will be just a drop in the bucket."
